character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create an original, highly polished 2D pixel-art character for ShieldQuest, a cozy Singaporean urban life-simulation adventure game.

CHARACTER: Eurasian Singaporean female café staff member, approximately 20–30 years old.

ART DIRECTION:
- Polished, cozy life-sim pixel art.
- Soft shading, clean selective outlines, modern premium indie feel.
- Slightly stylized but natural proportions.
- Charming and expressive face.

APPEARANCE:
- Light-medium skin tone.
- Brown hair tied back in a ponytail or tidy bob.
- Casual café apron over a simple top.
- Comfortable trousers.
- Sneakers or café work shoes.
- Friendly smile and approachable personality.

SINGAPOREAN IDENTITY:
- Modern urban café worker in Singapore.
- Clean, practical and slightly stylish.
- Suitable for a neighbourhood café or mall setting.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
- Full-body standing character, transparent background.
- Orthogonal low top-down perspective.
- Consistent proportions and silhouette.
- No background, no text, no fantasy elements.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET:
A premium cozy pixel-art café worker who fits naturally into a Singapore neighbourhood life-sim world.
